spans.s:
Toda appears once to denote a ‘goad’ in the Rigveda, but more often it is an agent noun meaning ‘impeller.’ Geldner considers that in one passage the sense is ‘wielder of the rod of punishment’ (later daṇḍa-dhara)--that is, ‘prince.’
Foot notes iv. 16, 11; mantra in kauśika sūtra, 107.
Rv. vi. 6, 6; 12, 1, 3, are probably so to be understood.
Vedische Studien, 3, 74.
Rv. i. 150, 1.
